title: Long-Horizon Autonomous Deep Research and Code Execution
oneLiner: DeerFlow orchestrates sub-agents, memory, and sandboxes to perform long-horizon, iterative research tasks, including writing and executing code to verify findings autonomously.
evidenceDetail: The provider's own documentation describes this workflow, its requirements, and its setup steps. Zyvibe checked the linked source on 2026-11-21 and has not reproduced the workflow.
whatItDoes: DeerFlow orchestrates sub-agents, memory, and sandboxes to perform long-horizon, iterative research tasks, including writing and executing code to verify findings autonomously.
requirements: access to DeerFlow repository or hosted API
steps: Submit a complex research query (e.g., "Compare the performance of three ML models on dataset X")
Monitor sub-agent execution and sandboxed code runs
